key_insight: SRPO reframes multi-agent RL updates around the active set of outputs consumed by one environment transition, aligning the optimization unit with the actual joint action.
engineering_relevance: This gives a single training interface for fixed, mixed, and dynamically routed multi-agent LLM workflows, making coordination optimization more practical across system designs.
method: Combine member log-ratios into one cardinality-normalized set ratio
Assign one relative advantage to the whole active set
Clip the set update once, instead of clipping each response separately
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning and multi-turn search across four model scales, with SRPO achieving the strongest macro-average results among the compared methods.
watch_item: Performance and stability may depend on how accurately the active set is defined and reduced into events, especially as set size and routing complexity change.
paper_title: SRPO: Setwise Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent LLMs
